ideas.name: any warning after a move made of jumps (3 bars, 40%)
ideas.why: batch 35's idea with a cut that occurs: the last 30 minutes' 3 biggest bars over 40% of the price travelled; moves made in jumps get faded

ideas.name: any warning after a fake flip
ideas.why: the box's last flip undone within 5 bars in the last half hour: the 1m trend is whipsawing, a chop where warnings (turns) pay

ideas.name: any warning after 3+ VWAP crosses in the hour
ideas.why: price crossing the day's VWAP three or more times in 60 minutes is balance around fair value, where turns rotate

ideas.name: any warning after the 1m rows split for 10+ bars
ideas.why: the EMA and MACD rows on opposite sides for 10 of the last 15 bars: no trend for the warning to turn, so its call is a coin flip or worse
